spec.description: Editable qualitative sketch using the house graph blue for the curve and black for the axes, ticks and labels.
spec.mathematics: Crosses the x-axis at (-1,0), passes through (0,1), has a local maximum left of the y-axis above 1, and touches the x-axis at its local minimum (1,0). The curve continues down to the left and up to the right. No function rule is specified.

spec.description: Editable qualitative sketch using house graph blue and black axes.
spec.mathematics: Touches the x-axis at (-1,0), passes through (0,1), turns at a local maximum right of the y-axis and crosses the x-axis at (1,0). The curve continues up to the left and down to the right.

answer.worked: The point where the curve touches the $x$-axis moves from $(1,0)$ to $(-1,0)$, and the $y$-intercept stays at $(0,1)$. This is reflection across the $y$-axis, giving $y=f(-x)$.

spec.description: Editable qualitative sketch using house graph blue and black axes.
spec.mathematics: Crosses the x-axis at (-1,0), has a local minimum left of the y-axis below -1, passes through (0,-1) and touches the x-axis at its local maximum (1,0). The curve continues up to the left and down to the right.

answer.worked: The point where the curve touches the $x$-axis stays at $(1,0)$, and the $y$-intercept moves from $(0,1)$ to $(0,-1)$. This is reflection across the $x$-axis, giving $y=-f(x)$.

spec.description: Editable qualitative sketch using house graph blue and black axes.
spec.mathematics: Touches the x-axis at its local maximum (-1,0), passes through (0,-1), has a local minimum right of the y-axis below -1 and crosses the x-axis at (1,0). The curve continues down to the left and up to the right.

answer.worked: The point where the curve touches the $x$-axis moves from $(1,0)$ to $(-1,0)$, and the $y$-intercept moves from $(0,1)$ to $(0,-1)$. Both coordinates change sign under the two reflections, giving $y=-f(-x)$.
